What if you chewed on your pen every single day?
Students and office workers do it the most. Lots of people do it while thinking, and it can feel calming. Chewing is a common way people release nervous energy.

But here's the twist. Pens can carry tons of germs, and biting hard plastic can crack teeth and wear down fillings. Swallowing a broken pen cap is also a real choking risk, especially for kids. That's why many pen caps have a tiny hole in the top, to let air through.
